notes: Upstream-clone debugging task on duckdb/duckdb at parent commit e0b375a9a0d52c40803e989ca030d05c99d56299 (real upstream issue duckdb/duckdb#25166, fixed upstream by commit 02f7eeb4dbc8f36c3ac3dec7132a262dbe769e35). DuckDB's printf %c conversion writes its argument's low byte raw, so printf('%c', 255) yields a VARCHAR holding byte 0xFF - a string that violates the invariant that VARCHAR is always valid UTF-8. Displaying the value then fails with a low-level 'invalid lead byte detected in Utf8Proc::UTF8ToCodepoint' error, string functions on the result (lower/upper/trim/reverse) throw 'INTERNAL Error ... but the function is not marked as fallible' plus a stack trace, and strip_accents segfaults (rc 139). The upstream fix adds a Utf8Proc::IsValid check of the formatted result in the path shared by printf and format (extension/core_functions/scalar/string/printf.cpp) and raises InvalidInputException 'Invalid UTF8 produced by format string ... use chr(...)' (message verified in-image on the fixed engine). The image clones the repo via git init + single shallow fetch (rev-list --all --count == 1; fix commit never fetched into /app/src), extracts the fix-commit regression test (test/sql/function/string/test_printf.test, sha b38d0fd2a2cecf1eb527575effcad0b3b883f9797818b1fff09349db5a7500ed) into /opt/golden via a throwaway bare clone that is deleted, and prebuilds the release engine + unittest runner (cmake -G Ninja -B build/release -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_UNITTESTS=1 -DEXTENSION_STATIC_BUILD=1 -DBUILD_EXTENSIONS=core_functions; ninja -j24, measured 135s). Unlike the earlier duckdb tasks, the trial tree keeps the PINNED PARENT's test_printf.test (the buggy engine passes it), so the agent is not handed the failing regression: it must write its own failing reproduction /app/reproduce.sh from the user-symptom instruction, before fixing. The unittest runner reads .test content from the tree at runtime while the path list is baked at build time (verified empirically), so the verifier copies /opt/golden/test_printf.test over the tree copy at verify time to run the golden gate with the project's own runner; the copy is byte-pinned (sha256) and the parent's version is restored afterwards. The rebuilt binaries at /app/src/build/release are forced to come from the agent's real sources by touching printf.cpp before an incremental ninja -j1 relink (measured 25s per fix cycle at 1 CPU). The verifier also: asserts provenance (HEAD == parent, exactly one commit, fix commit object absent, porcelain == exactly ' M extension/core_functions/scalar/string/printf.cpp', tree test_printf.test byte-identical to the pinned parent's, /app/reproduce.sh present/executable and invoking the project binary); requires the golden test and the project's own test/sql/function/string/* suite (82 sqllogictest cases, 4444 assertions, 4s) to pass; runs four authored hidden cases through the CLI on rebuilt-engine inputs the upstream regression does not use (embedded %c positions and continuation bytes 128/191/194/233, consumer functions upper/trim/reverse/strip_accents, vectorized rows incl. range(200,210) WHERE i % 2 = 0 and range(0,300) WHERE i % 3 = 2, and valid-side sanity: 'B', 'Hi!', 'xAy', NULL, count 5, length(chr(255)) == 1, equality with chr(255) -- every ERROR hidden query provably fails at the parent binary with 'invalid lead byte'/'truncated UTF-8 sequence'/INTERNAL errors and passes on the fixed engine with the exact fixed message); and runs /app/reproduce.sh twice, against the preserved pre-fix CLI snapshot (/opt/pristine/duckdb) where it must fail with buggy markers, and against the repaired engine where it must exit 0 with the fixed message, with differing outputs (each leg hard-asserted; a hardcoded script cannot satisfy both). Environment: bench-base:ubuntu-24.04, apt g++/gcc/make/cmake/ninja-build/python3/git, cpus=1, OMP numeric pins, no pip pins ({}). Difficulty rubric total 11 (medium): higher debugging_ambiguity than the sibling duckdb tasks (no reproduction in the instruction, no failing test visible in the tree; the agent must author a two-sided reproduction that satisfies the pre-fix/fixed leg contract), reasoning_depth 2 (locate the single UTF-8-write choke point shared by printf and format in a large C++ codebase), hidden_case_generalization 2. Both directions re-confirmed inside the task image (smoke layer asserts the golden FAILS at parent and the CLI shows 'invalid lead byte'/'INTERNAL Error'; oracle direction re-confirmed through verify_new_task.sh).
